title: Monitoring and Logging
subtitle: Measure what users feel, spend an error budget on it, and page only when the budget burns fast
motto: You cannot fix what you cannot see, and you cannot see everything, so alert on what users feel
coreAddition: metrics, logs, traces and SLO alerts
keyInsight: Monitoring turns a 4-hour night into a 15-minute one, but alerts on the wrong signal, like CPU, add noise and still miss real incidents.

decisions.title: Run the same incident through four setups
decisions.description: The frames replay one incident with no monitoring, with alerts, with CPU alerts and with burn-rate alerts, so downtime and pages are comparable.
decisions.alternatives: Describing the three pillars alone would not show what each choice costs in minutes and pages.

decisions.title: Show CPU alerts as the failure
decisions.description: CPU is the alert most teams start with, and the failure frame shows both its noise and the incidents it misses.
decisions.alternatives: Going straight to burn-rate alerts would skip why the common first choice is weak.
